items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Was he Ed Lang? I don't know.

ctx.x: Old numbers. Beautiful doll. And Take Your Hands Away. And Blues. A whole lot of blues, you know. A lot of blues. Oh, he was a fine guitar, man. He's the guitar on this, I think. Yeah, but the only thing. Did you ever hear of Blind Willie Dunn? Yeah, I heard him. Was he Ed Lang? I don't know.
Where did you hear Blind Willie Dunn?
